title: OpenAI DayBreak – GPT-5.5-Cyber
summary: OpenAI launched the DayBreak initiative featuring GPT-5.5-Cyber, an AI-powered cybersecurity solution designed to help defend against evolving digital threats. The project appears to leverage advanced language models specifically optimized for security applications.
problem_solved: Addresses the growing sophistication of cyber threats by providing AI-driven security capabilities to protect digital infrastructure worldwide.
why_valuable: Combines OpenAI's cutting-edge language model technology with cybersecurity expertise to create proactive defense mechanisms against modern digital attacks.
